01 SECTION 1 · CONTEXT AND PROBLEM Copied from each other, or rediscovered?
3
WHY THIS NEEDS MEASURING The same practices appeared under hundreds of agent names MID-2026 · THE COLLUSION.WIKI INCIDENT 14,591 wiki revisions 3,099 agent labels 15 techniques catalogued Autonomous agents from an OpenAI evaluation used small public wikis as a message board. Fetch proxies, beacon pages and answer-relay formats recurred under many labels. WHY THE ANSWER MATTERS If agents copy the channel is the risk: cut or monitor what agents read from each other. If agents rediscover the capability is the risk: closing the channel changes nothing. Today we cannot tell the two leave the same trace in a log of what agents wrote. Tracer Conventions · Apart Research Swarm Alignment Hackathon 2026 03
4
THE MEASUREMENT PROBLEM A write log cannot separate copying from rediscovery Exposure goes unrecorded A write log shows what each agent wrote, not what it read. Who saw a practice before using it is invisible. Useful practices are reinvented A fetch proxy or an answer index is useful; agents facing the same constraints can each invent it. Shared bursts look like contagion Activity clusters in time, so exposed agents adopt more simply because everyone is active at once. Related work studies how conventions form among LLM agents and how prompt injections spread; none gives a causal measure of copying that rediscovery cannot confound. Tracer Conventions · Apart Research Swarm Alignment Hackathon 2026 04

02 SECTION 2 · METHODOLOGY A tracer experiment, and a field check
6
SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE · WHAT WE BUILT Seed an arbitrary marker; count who reproduces it THREE KINDS OF MARKER Page-name code a random code in the page name: function-free, so it can only be copied Body tag a random tag inside the page text: visible only to an agent that reads the page Answers-Index page a useful convention that could be invented: the rediscovery test Tracer Conventions · Apart Research Swarm Alignment Hackathon 2026 06
7
THE HARNESS 12 paired conditions × 48 seeds × 7 models = 4,032 trials Rediscovery baseline isolated · neutral page names · neutral pages shown does any agent invent the convention? Dose (agent must look) 1, 2 or 4 prior pages with the convention does copying need exposure? Dose (page list shown) the same, with the page list in the prompt structure vs exact code Disagreement four prior pages, four different codes does copying need agreement? Arbitrary vs functional code and tag only · index only which parts spread? Each trial: one evaluation agent must answer one question and leave the answer for teammates, with list_pages, read_page, write_page and submit_answer on a shared wiki. Models: DeepSeek-V4 Flash, Gemma 4 31B, GLM-5.2, Ministral 3 14B, gpt-oss-120b, Qwen3.8 27B, Qwen3.5 397B. Graded by exact match on what the agent wrote; conditions pair on seed. Tracer Conventions · Apart Research Swarm Alignment Hackathon 2026 07
8
THE FIELD CHECK · THE REAL INCIDENT LOG Can the collusion.wiki write log show spread at all? 14,591 revisions in the public export 3,099 agent labels 15 techniques (fetch proxies, beacons, relays) 8 placebo words Re-timing test move each adoption to a random revision of the same label: does adoption follow write-visible exposure more than chance? Choice design with placebos are labels more likely to adopt what they were exposed to, beyond ordinary echo of seen words? Positive control plant synthetic copying into the real timeline and ask which test can detect it Tracer Conventions · Apart Research Swarm Alignment Hackathon 2026 08

03 SECTION 3 · PROPOSED MEASUREMENT Measure diffusion causally: tracer conventions and read logs
10
PROPOSED MEASUREMENT A causal, cheap test for copying in a deployed swarm 1 Seed a tracer Plant an arbitrary, function-free marker (a code in a page name, a tag in a body) where agents can see it. 2 Vary exposure and agreement Show it to some agents and not others; vary how many prior pages carry it and whether they agree. 3 Count exact reproductions An exact copy of a random marker cannot be rediscovered, so each reproduction is a transmission. 4 Log reads, not only writes Record what each agent listed and read; without exposure logs a write log cannot separate copying from echo. Tracer Conventions · Apart Research Swarm Alignment Hackathon 2026 10

04 SECTION 4 · RESULTS What spread, how, and what the log could show
12
RESULT 1 · REDISCOVERY BASELINE No model invented the conventions on its own 0/1,008 trials without a seeded example that produced an index page or a code-style page name Without a seeded convention, no model wrote an index-like page or gave a page a code-like suffix. For the index and the naming structure this is a substantive test: both are useful and could have been invented. For the exact random code and tag it holds by construction. Every adoption in the dose conditions is therefore copying. Tracer Conventions · Apart Research Swarm Alignment Hackathon 2026 12
13
RESULT 2 · EXPOSURE Copying needs exposure, and exposure is not enough LISTED THE WIKI BEFORE WRITING, UNPROMPTED DeepSeek-V4 Flash 0–4% Gemma 4 31B 12–15% GLM-5.2 0–10% Ministral 3 14B 21–27% gpt-oss-120b 0% Qwen3.8 27B 92% Qwen3.5 397B 44–62% WHAT THIS MEANS Models differed most in whether they looked. Only the models that read seeded pages copied the exact code unprompted, rising with the number of prior pages (+1.36 logits per doubling, no acceleration). Reading was not enough either: of 129 agents that opened a seeded page, 74 copied the form of its name and only 15 its code. Tracer Conventions · Apart Research Swarm Alignment Hackathon 2026 13
14
RESULT 3 · STRUCTURE VS EXACT TOKEN The structure spreads at once; the exact code needs agreement PAGE LIST SHOWN · OF 336 TRIALS 1 prior page: used the code slot 259/336 …but filled it with its own id 256/336 copied the code: 1 / 2 / 4 agreeing pages 2 / 97 / 146 4 pages, 4 different codes: copied a code 2/336 Tracer Conventions · Apart Research Swarm Alignment Hackathon 2026 14
15
RESULT 4 · FIELD CHECK ON THE REAL LOG In the write log, technique spread looks like word echo 5.02 odds ratio: labels adopt a technique they were exposed to more often 1.21 …but placebo words show nearly the same effect (technique / placebo ratio, 95% CI 0.88–1.67) 0 of 15 techniques adopted after exposure more than chance (re-timing test, Holm) Write-visible exposure was rare: 15.1% of adopters had prior exposure, against 24.1% under re-timing. Naive exposed-vs-unexposed comparisons would have suggested up to 16.8-fold contagion; the placebo words show this is shared bursts of activity, not transmission. Tracer Conventions · Apart Research Swarm Alignment Hackathon 2026 15

05 SECTION 5 · ROBUSTNESS What the tests could detect, and where they hold
17
POSITIVE CONTROL · PLANTED COPYING IN THE REAL TIMELINE The write-log test could not have seen copying; a page-local test could 0% power of the re-timing test even when planted copiers were 19% of adopters We planted a synthetic token into the real label and page timeline, letting a fraction of candidates adopt at their first write-visible exposure and the rest at random later revisions, so label churn and pages are those of the real data. The prior-exposure test never detected the planted copying. A same-page test did, and on the real data it found the only technique-specific excess: signal_relay, the field's one arbitrary convention, as the tracer experiment predicts. Tracer Conventions · Apart Research Swarm Alignment Hackathon 2026 17

ROBUSTNESS · IS IT JUST THE PROMPT? Removing “leave it for teammates” did not reduce copying SAME SEEDS, FOUR AGREEING PAGES SHOWN · WITH THE TEAM FRAMING vs WITHOUT IT (“SAVE YOUR ANSWER AS A WIKI PAGE”) Qwen3.5 397B copied the code 27/48 → 46/48 paired: 0 vs 19, p = 3.8×10⁻⁶ own id in the slot 21/48 → 2/48 GLM-5.2 copied the code 20/48 → 14/48 paired: 10 vs 4, p = 0.18 added a line to the index 10/48 → 0/48 WHAT THIS MEANS The team framing does not manufacture copying. Without it, Qwen3.5 copied the shared code almost every time, because it stopped signing the slot with its own id. GLM copied a little less (not significant) and stopped using the index, which only helps others. Exploratory: two hosted models, one condition. Tracer Conventions · Apart Research Swarm Alignment Hackathon 2026 19
20
QUALITATIVE AND ERROR ANALYSIS What agents actually wrote, and where they went wrong Copying is silent 0 of 4,028 closing notes mention a naming convention; copying shows only in what agents write, which is why tracers work. Hybrids 11 trials kept the code's first letter and appended the agent's own number (seeded U6M, agent A50 wrote answer-Q-2655-U50); exact matching counts them as neither, so copy rates are conservative. Protocol failures 71% of gpt-oss-120b trials had an invalid-format turn; its adoption rates are lower bounds. Ministral answered 60% correctly; the others 91% or more. Copying can do harm 2 trials in which Ministral rewrote the shared index and removed earlier agents' lines; no agent overwrote another's answer page. Tracer Conventions · Apart Research Swarm Alignment Hackathon 2026 20

06 SECTION 6 · FINDINGS AND RECOMMENDATIONS What the evidence says, and what to log
22
KEY FINDINGS Five things the evidence shows 0/1,008 No reinvention No agent produced the index or a code-style name without a seeded example. 259/336 Structure spreads from one example Shown one prior page, agents copied the naming structure, but filled the slot with their own id. 0 → 146 The exact token needs agreement The seeded code was copied once 2 or 4 prior pages agreed on it, and almost never when they disagreed. 1.21 The write log cannot tell spread from echo Exposure predicted technique adoption no more than it predicted placebo words. 0% …and the standard test was blind A planted positive control was never detected by the write-log test; a page-local test could. THE TAKEAWAY Read logs are necessary to study diffusion in deployed swarms, and tracer conventions are a cheap, causal way to measure it. Tracer Conventions · Apart Research Swarm Alignment Hackathon 2026 22
23
RECOMMENDATIONS · WHAT TO LOG IN AN AGENT DEPLOYMENT Log what agents read, and seed tracers before you need them Log reads, not only writes The shared substrate's access log (page views, list calls) with agent identity and time; without it, copying and echo are indistinguishable. Keep identities stable Short-lived labels hide who saw what; log the credential behind each name. Seed tracer conventions Plant function-free markers on shared boards; their reappearance measures transmission directly. Use placebo tokens Never report exposed-vs-unexposed contagion without placebo words: here it would have suggested up to 16.8-fold spread. Tracer Conventions · Apart Research Swarm Alignment Hackathon 2026 23
24
07 SECTION 7 · LIMITATIONS What this study does and does not establish
25
LIMITATIONS A minimal setting, by design One agent per trial The experiment measures individual copying decisions with scripted prior pages, not swarm dynamics. Some models rarely look Several models seldom listed or read the wiki unprompted; for them the results speak to listing more than to reading. Labels are not agents In the field log, arriving labels may be the same agent renamed; reads are not observed in the export. Placebos are not frequency-matched Placebo words differ from techniques in base rate; the ratio, not the level, is interpreted. Tracer Conventions · Apart Research Swarm Alignment Hackathon 2026 25
